scripts.prep: rimraf build && cd ../web-react && bun run build && cd ../desktop-webview && cpy "../web-react/dist/**" build/dist && cpy icon.ico build
scripts.build:win-x64: bun run prep && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap=none --target=bun-windows-x64 --windows-hide-console --windows-icon=icon.ico ./index.ts --outfile build/ahprofit-windows-x64.exe
scripts.build:linux-x64: bun run prep && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap=none --target=bun-linux-x64 ./index.ts --outfile build/ahprofit-linux-x64
scripts.build:linux-arm64: bun run prep && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap=none --target=bun-linux-arm64 ./index.ts --outfile build/ahprofit-linux-arm64
scripts.build:darwin-x64: bun run prep && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap=none --target=bun-darwin-x64 ./index.ts --outfile build/ahprofit-darwin-x64
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: bun run prep && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap=none --target=bun-darwin-arm64 ./index.ts --outfile build/ahprofit-darwin-arm64
